purpose: Verify Super Admin can create a hostel record
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; hostel record does not already exist
action_or_input: Open create-hostel function, enter hostel identification and master data, submit
expected_result: New hostel record is created and stored in HM

purpose: Verify Super Admin can activate or deactivate a hostel record
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; hostel record exists
action_or_input: Open hostel record, select Deactivate, then select Activate
expected_result: Activation status is recorded as inactive, then as active, and is available to HM functions using hostel records

purpose: Verify Super Admin can assign, reassign, activate or deactivate a Warden role binding
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; hostel exists
action_or_input: Select hostel, assign Warden binding, then reassign it and toggle status
expected_result: Binding and status are recorded for the hostel; hostel-specific access visibility is applied; new holder can view pending HM records for the hostel

purpose: Verify Super Admin can assign, reassign, activate or deactivate a Caretaker role binding
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; hostel exists
action_or_input: Select hostel, assign Caretaker binding, then reassign it and toggle status
expected_result: Binding and status are recorded for the hostel; hostel-specific access visibility is applied; new holder can view pending HM records for the hostel

purpose: Verify Student can submit a hostel accommodation request
preconditions: Student authenticated
action_or_input: Open accommodation request form, enter details, submit
expected_result: Request details and an initial request status are recorded for allotment processing

purpose: Verify Super Admin can record hostel and room allotment decisions
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; accommodation records and rooms with available capacity exist
action_or_input: Open allotment decision function, record hostel and room allotment for a student
expected_result: Allotment decision, room assignment, occupancy and room-assignment history are recorded; allocation status notification is issued

purpose: Verify allotment exceeding room capacity is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; target room is at defined capacity
action_or_input: Record an allotment into the full room
expected_result: Update is rejected and prior occupancy state is preserved

purpose: Verify central re-allotment and formal room-vacation can be recorded
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; student has a current room assignment; target room has capacity
action_or_input: Record a central re-allotment; then record a formal room-vacation for another assignment
expected_result: Re-allotment creates a new assignment; vacation removes the current assignment/occupancy; room history is updated; notification is issued

purpose: Verify re-allotment exceeding room capacity is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; target room is at defined capacity
action_or_input: Record a central re-allotment into the full room
expected_result: Update is rejected and prior occupancy state is preserved

purpose: Verify Student can view current and historical room allocation
preconditions: Student authenticated; student has current and past allocations
action_or_input: Open room allocation view
expected_result: Current room allocation and historical allocation information are displayed for that student only

purpose: Verify Caretaker can maintain room availability and occupancy
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift
action_or_input: Open room availability/occupancy function, update room status and an occupancy value within capacity
expected_result: Updated availability/occupancy information is stored

purpose: Verify occupancy update exceeding capacity is rejected
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; room at defined capacity
action_or_input: Record an occupancy update exceeding capacity
expected_result: Update is rejected; existing occupancy unchanged

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record an individual room exchange
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift; exchange keeps rooms within capacity
action_or_input: Select student and room assignment, record the exchange
expected_result: Affected assignments, occupancy, room status and history are updated; room-allocation-change notification is issued

purpose: Verify exchange exceeding capacity is not recorded
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; exchange would exceed a room’s capacity
action_or_input: Record the exchange
expected_result: Exchange is not recorded; existing records unchanged

purpose: Verify Warden can review room assignments and occupancy
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding
action_or_input: Open room assignment/occupancy review
expected_result: Room assignment, utilization, occupancy and room-change information for the hostel is displayed

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record and monitor attendance
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift
action_or_input: Open attendance function, record attendance for students
expected_result: Attendance records are stored and available for authorized review/reporting

purpose: Verify Student can view own attendance information
preconditions: Student authenticated; attendance data exists
action_or_input: Open attendance-status view
expected_result: Student’s own attendance information is displayed; no state change

purpose: Verify Student can submit a leave request
preconditions: Student authenticated
action_or_input: Open leave form, enter details and any configured supporting information, submit
expected_result: Leave request is recorded with status, retained in leave history, available for Caretaker review; submission notification is issued

purpose: Verify Caretaker can approve or reject a leave request
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift; pending leave request exists
action_or_input: Open request, record Approval for one request and Rejection for another
expected_result: Request states become Approved and Rejected respectively; leave history retained; decision notification issued

purpose: Verify Student can view own leave status and history
preconditions: Student authenticated; leave records exist
action_or_input: Open leave status/history view
expected_result: Student’s own leave status and history are displayed; no state change

purpose: Verify Student can submit a hostel-related complaint
preconditions: Student authenticated
action_or_input: Open complaint form, enter category and description (optional attachment), submit
expected_result: Complaint and initial status are recorded for Caretaker handling; submission notification is issued

purpose: Verify out-of-scope matter is not treated as an HM hostel complaint
preconditions: Student authenticated
action_or_input: Submit a matter outside hostel-related complaint scope
expected_result: HM does not treat it as a hostel complaint and no central complaint routing occurs

purpose: Verify Caretaker can review, update, resolve and escalate a complaint
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift; submitted complaint exists
action_or_input: Open complaint, record action and status (resolved); on another complaint record unresolved update; on another record escalation to Warden
expected_result: Action and status are stored; resolved status stored; unresolved remains unresolved; escalation recorded where supported; update/resolution notification issued

purpose: Verify Warden can monitor complaint status and history
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding; complaints exist
action_or_input: Open complaint monitoring view
expected_result: Unresolved, delayed, escalated and historical complaint information within permitted scope is displayed

purpose: Verify Student can submit a guest-room booking request
preconditions: Student authenticated
action_or_input: Open booking form, enter details, submit
expected_result: Request with initial booking status is recorded and retained in booking history; booking status notification is issued

purpose: Verify Caretaker can approve or reject a guest-room booking request
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift; pending booking request exists
action_or_input: Open pending request, view availability, record approval for one and rejection for another
expected_result: Booking status is updated and booking history maintained

purpose: Verify Student can view own guest-room booking status
preconditions: Student authenticated; booking request exists
action_or_input: Open guest-room booking status
expected_result: Student’s own booking requests and status are displayed; no state change

purpose: Verify Student can submit an extended-stay request
preconditions: Student authenticated
action_or_input: Open extended-stay form, enter requested period and details, submit
expected_result: Requested period and decision status are recorded for Warden review

purpose: Verify Warden can approve or reject an extended-stay request
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding; submitted extended-stay request exists
action_or_input: Open request, review details and any charge/deadline/compliance info, record approval for one and rejection for another
expected_result: Decision status, actor and timestamp are recorded (Approved/Rejected); status notification is issued

purpose: Verify supplied charge/deadline/compliance information is recorded against an extended-stay request
preconditions: Extended-stay request exists; configured source supplies charge/deadline/compliance data
action_or_input: Configured source supplies charge, payment deadline and compliance information for the request
expected_result: HM associates and records the information with the request and makes it available for Warden review

purpose: Verify HM does not invent values when source supplies no usable information
preconditions: Extended-stay request exists; source supplies no usable information
action_or_input: Source provides no usable charge/deadline/compliance data
expected_result: No unsupported value is created or inferred

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record a hostel fine
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift
action_or_input: Open fine function, enter affected student, reason, amount, date, submit
expected_result: Fine record is stored and visible for permitted review; fine-imposition notification issued where applicable

purpose: Verify Student can view own fine records and history
preconditions: Student authenticated; fine records exist
action_or_input: Open fine records/history view
expected_result: Student’s own imposed fines and history are displayed; no state change

purpose: Verify Caretaker can maintain hostel inventory records
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; within assigned hostel and shift
action_or_input: Open inventory records, record an inventory update or usage change
expected_result: Inventory records (and accountability logs where maintained) are stored

purpose: Verify authorized role can maintain and view staff coordination information
preconditions: Authorized hostel role authenticated, with maintenance permission for one actor and view-only for another
action_or_input: Maintenance actor updates a staff-coordination record; view-only actor opens the same records
expected_result: Permitted update is stored; view-only action leaves records unchanged

purpose: Verify Warden can maintain security guard shift schedule
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding
action_or_input: Open guard shift schedule function, record or update a shift schedule
expected_result: Updated schedule is stored and available for monitoring/review

purpose: Verify Caretaker or Warden can publish a notice for an assigned hostel
preconditions: Caretaker or Warden authenticated; target hostel is assigned to the actor
action_or_input: Open notice function, enter content, publish
expected_result: Notice is displayed on the hostel notice board and recorded in notice history

purpose: Verify authorized users can view hostel notices
preconditions: Authorized user authenticated; published notices exist
action_or_input: Open hostel notice board
expected_result: Notices visible to the user within hostel/access scope are displayed with history/reference where maintained

purpose: Verify role-scoped report generation
preconditions: Caretaker, Warden and Super Admin each authenticated; HM records exist
action_or_input: Each actor opens the reports function and generates a predefined report
expected_result: Caretaker sees hostel-level options, Warden supervisory options, Super Admin institution-level/cross-hostel options; selected report is generated from HM records

purpose: Verify notification/status update is issued on a supported HM event
preconditions: Configured notification mechanism available
action_or_input: Trigger a supported event (e.g., leave decision recorded)
expected_result: Notification/status update is issued to relevant recipients through the configured mechanism

purpose: Verify failed notification is not represented as issued
preconditions: Configured notification mechanism cannot accept the notification
action_or_input: Trigger a supported event
expected_result: System does not represent the notification as successfully issued

purpose: Verify Warden can review attendance summaries, trends and exceptions
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding; attendance data exists
action_or_input: Open attendance oversight view
expected_result: Attendance summaries, trends and exceptions for permitted scope are displayed; no records changed

purpose: Verify Warden can review leave information and summaries
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding; leave data exists
action_or_input: Open leave oversight view
expected_result: Leave information and summaries for permitted scope are displayed; no request or decision state changed

purpose: Verify Warden can review fine summaries and disciplinary patterns
preconditions: Warden authenticated; hostel within active role binding; fine data exists
action_or_input: Open fine/disciplinary summary view
expected_result: Fine summaries and disciplinary patterns for permitted scope are displayed; no fine record changed

purpose: Verify Warden and Super Admin scoped review of staff assignments/shift information
preconditions: Warden (with hostel binding) and Super Admin authenticated; staff assignment data exists for multiple hostels
action_or_input: Each actor opens the staff-assignment/shift review view
expected_result: Warden sees only permitted hostel scope; Super Admin sees institution-level scope; no records changed
